Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class EvaluationCycleDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.EvaluationCycleDTO
public class EvaluationCycleDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for EvaluationCycle entity.

Encapsulates all relevant data representing a full evaluation cycle, including lifecycle dates, status, creator metadata, and associated evaluations. Designed for transmission between services and REST API layers.

Key fields: - id: Unique cycle identifier - createdAt: Timestamp of cycle creation - startDate, endDate, closureDate: Temporal bounds for evaluation activity - status: Current lifecycle state - createdById: ID of the user who initiated the cycle - evaluations: List of evaluations tied to this cycle
